description: Boundary coverage for removing a stored value and reverting to default: removing when the store is empty so the re-read value equals the value already observed (the per-observer duplicate suppression prevents a second emission), removing when the preset value already equals the default, and removing twice in a row so the second removal re-reads an already-default value. Each removal still delegates one deletion to the backing store and reports its result.

cases.expected_output:
emit[0] default value
store remove key=key
remove ok=true

emit[0] default value
store remove key=key
remove ok=true

emit[0] stored
store remove key=key
remove ok=true
emit[0] default value
store remove key=key
remove ok=true
